entries.note: Marcus adopts the reported figures and asserts the sustainability conclusion in his own voice.

entries.test: Contemporaneous financial disclosures, documented security vulnerabilities, and public surveys of concern would test the claims of limited earnings, insecurity, and widespread worry.
entries.note: “Keeping a lot of people up at night” has a plain figurative reading as causing worry.

entries.test: Independent evaluations establishing that generative AI has durably overcome hallucinations and comparable core failures would falsify the persistence claim.
entries.note: This is a firm persistence forecast without a deadline; continued failures alone cannot conclusively establish indefinite persistence.
